title: link/tasks read path folds references like the rollup (referenceKey), fold-table ICU digest pin, generator nits (#745 verdict should-fix 1 and 2)
description: From the Opus round-2 verdict on #745 (approved at feaad1c1, merged as a127c2d7). SHOULD-FIX 1 (in 0.15.1, leader ruling M2): src/commands/link.ts verifiedViewTask (:884-885) still compares detail.id and aliases with toLowerCase, while the rollup path (check, sync) now matches by referenceKey (NFC plus per-code-point fold, as quest's aliasKey). For a task whose id or alias is straße, a concept linking STRASSE resolves in check/sync but lore link / lore tasks / lore orphans throws not_found 'resolved to a different task'; the same for an NFD spelling of an NFC alias. Fix: compare with referenceKey (export it from the adapter or move it to a shared module). SHOULD-FIX 2 (M3, same PR if small): the 297-entry fold table is a delta against the generating node's toLowerCase, and referenceKey relies on the RUNNING bun's toLowerCase for everything else, which can differ by platform ICU; nothing checks it. Add a bun test pinning a digest of cp -> cp.toLowerCase() over U+0000..U+10FFFF, have the generator print that digest plus process.versions.icu and process.versions.unicode; it runs on all CI OSes. If the digest differs between OSes in CI, STOP and report per-OS values (a pair question), do not pick one. M4 nits: scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs:115 readCommitted should anchor the block end on the two-character sequence semicolon-newline rather than the first semicolon; reword the quest.ts rollupIndex docblock line that says the per-task path rejects a malformed-aliases record as drift (a real quest fails the whole load for a malformed aliases, so a per-task view fails for every reference). Handshake line to record on LBUMP/LCLI-469: lore's fold table is pinned to unicode-case-folding 1.1.1; a quest lockfile bump of that library must re-run gen-case-fold-table. FLOOR: scripts/ change gets a reviewer pass; no .github/, dependencies or lockfile.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore link, lore tasks and lore orphans resolve a task whose id or alias is straße when referenced as STRASSE, and an NFC alias referenced in NFD, via referenceKey; each test red without the fix.

A bun test pins the sha256 of the generated full unicode-case-folding 1.1.1 fold table (src/adapters/case-fold-table.ts), and the generator prints that digest; the superseded toLowerCase-over-all-code-points digest pin is not required (DEC-282 (a12)).
Generator block-end anchor and the rollupIndex docblock wording fixed.
The pair-release handshake line about unicode-case-folding 1.1.1 is recorded on the release task.

implementationNotes:
Review verdicts: opum-ai/lore-cli#749 APPROVE at 2321b819, opum-ai/lore-cli#750 APPROVE at eba6d0dc. Nothing blocks either PR. LCLI-807 must not close on #749 (tracker point T below).

How this was done: read-only with no shell, so nothing was run. CI is quoted from your brief. quest-cli was read from its working tree at an unknown ref. unicode-case-folding@1.1.1 was read from the bun cache copy (~/.bun/install/cache/unicode-case-folding@1.1.1@@@1), whose shasum I did not verify. The red-on-pre-fix claims and the mutant analyses below are derived by reading the code, not by running anything.

Lockfile: no package.json, bun.lock or npm/ path appears in either file list. #749 changes .quest/tasks/LCLI-807.json, scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs, src/adapters/quest.ts, src/commands/link.ts and test/{link,orphans,tasks}.test.ts. #750 changes scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs, src/adapters/case-fold-table.ts (new), src/adapters/quest.ts and test/lcli791-quest-rollup.test.ts. The floor's "lockfile" hit is the prose at line 7 of #749's diff, the LCLI-807 record ("a quest lockfile bump…", "no .github/, dependencies or lockfile"), not a changed file.

== opum-ai/lore-cli#749 ==
VERDICT: APPROVE, head 2321b819e066cd4d0db259a3bce89190246b197f

#745 r2 should-fix and nit mapping:
- SF1 (link.ts verifiedViewTask uses toLowerCase): RESOLVED at the named site.
  - link.ts:888-890 now compares referenceKey(taskId) with referenceKey(detail.id) and each alias.
  - That covers every verifiedViewTask consumer: link's pre-write check, re-read, unlink's removal read, moveBackRefs, tasks.ts resolveRollup (:170), and resolveTaskDetails (the orphans confirmation and the non-rollup fallback).
  - Adjacent membership comparisons remain; see should-fix 1.
- SF2 (the fold table depends on the runtime's toLowerCase): NOT ADDRESSED in #749, by design. 909b59bf added the toLowerCase digest pin, CI 44935202893 measured it diverging across OSes, 2321b819 removed it, and (a12) chose the full map, which #750 delivers. Resolved by #750.
- Nit 1 (cache-key VERSION mutant): not addressed; out of scope.
- Nit 2 (F7 docblock): RESOLVED at quest.ts:1048-1050.
- Nit 3 (empty-reference docblock): not addressed. The same line survives into #750 at quest.ts:994-995.
- Nit 4 (quest's ^1.1.1 range): not addressed in code. It is carried as LCLI-807 AC3 (the handshake line), which is unchecked and not visibly done.
- Nit 5 (readCommitted ends at the first ';'): RESOLVED in a different form. It anchors on `;\n` rather than the suggested `";\n`. CRLF is moot because .gitattributes sets eol=lf. See the nit below.

The 8 new tests: all are red on the pre-fix `toLowerCase` comparison (derived).
- STRASSE vs straße: "strasse" ≠ "straße", so verifiedViewTask throws not_found. Red in the direct test, the linkCmd test, the orphans test (the reference stays dangling) and the tasks test.
- NFD vs NFC: toLowerCase does not normalise, so the same four tests are red.
- I checked the literals by code point. The NFD strings at link.test.ts:181 and :203, orphans.test.ts:787 and tasks.test.ts:497 contain e+U+0301. The NFC aliases at link.test.ts:180 and :204, orphans.test.ts:789 and tasks.test.ts:499 contain U+00E9. So the NFD tests are not vacuous.

Generator pass (#749 delta, readCommitted :106-113): sound for the generated file. See nit 1.

Findings
Blocking: none.

Should-fix 1: src/commands/orphans.ts:262, :276 and :286-288 (outside the diff). AC0 names `lore orphans`, but orphan-task classification still compares by toLowerCase.
- `referenced` holds the reference lowercased, and a task counts as linked only if `referenced.has(task.id.toLowerCase())`. Aliases are never consulted (that part is pre-existing, even for ASCII).
- Failure scenario: the new test at test/orphans.test.ts:777-784 itself. Its report has danglingLinks: [] but orphanTasks: [{id:"straße"}], because makeTask has labels: [] and documentation: []. The NFD/alias test at :786-794 likewise lists T-1 as an orphan.
- In real use: a concept whose frontmatter says `tasks: [STRASSE]` (written by hand; `lore link` adds a doc: label, which exempts the task) gets a report saying the link is live while the task it points at is an orphan.
- Not a regression, so it does not block. But AC0 cannot honestly be checked as written. Fix: classify by referenceKey over the id and aliases, and add `expect(data.orphanTasks).toEqual([])` to both new tests; that assertion is red today. Or narrow AC0 and file the residual.

Should-fix 2 (follow-up, outside LCLI-807's stated scope): the other places that compare two DIFFERENT strings Quest would compare by aliasKey still use toLowerCase.
- link.ts:1095 containsCaseInsensitive, used at :302 and :445-449.
  - `lore link c STRASSE` when the concept already lists `straße` reports "added" and writes both.
  - `lore unlink c STRASSE` reports "not-linked" and leaves `straße` in place.
- link.ts:1069 dedupeTaskIds keeps both `straße` and `strasse`, so the lore:tasks rollup lists the same task twice.
- core/projection.ts:206-213 builds task edges keyed by toLowerCase, so the STRASSE→straße edge is projected as dangling. Its record keys also depend on the engine's toLowerCase for non-ASCII ids.
- Checked and harmless, because they key and look up the SAME requested string: the map keys in reconcile-shared.ts resolveRollupDetails/resolveTaskDetails/pickResolved (:230, :270-364) and the confirmDanglingLinks key/lookup (orphans.ts:322-327).

Nit 1: scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs:142-144 (as of #750). The new comment says the `;\n` anchor also copes with a trailing comment. It does the reverse: `...";  // note` followed by a newline is not `;\n`, so indexOf jumps to a later statement's `;\n` and pulls any string literal in between into `data`. Harmless today because the file is generated and the gap contains no literal; fix the comment or anchor on `";` followed by optional spaces and a newline.

Nit 2: link.test.ts:180's comment says "e + combining acute, composed", but the literal is the precomposed U+00E9 with no combining mark. The same wording appears at lcli791 test :445.

Nit 3: no CHANGELOG entry for a user-visible fix (link/tasks/orphans now resolve fold-equal ids and NFD spellings).

Nit 4 (assumption stated): verifiedViewTask is backend-agnostic, so the fold also loosens identity matching for Backlog and Jira. That is harmless only if their ids are ASCII, which I assume. The guard can only accept more, never reject more.

== opum-ai/lore-cli#750 (delta 2321b819..eba6d0dc) ==
VERDICT: APPROVE, head eba6d0dc57fee27634aebfa322f8c5a9aba816f4

(a12) conformance
- Full map, 1585 entries: VERIFIED against the library.
  - The FOLDING_MAP literal (index.js line 8) holds exactly 1585 `[cp,[` entries; the 1583rd to 1585th are 125215, 125216 and 125217.
  - The table's last key is U+1E921, the library's last key.
  - Entries spot-checked as identical on both sides: 304→[105,775], 7838→ss, 8123→[8049], 42972→[411], 43888→[5024], 68944→[68976], 93856→[93883], 125217→[125251]. 5024 (U+13A0) is absent on both sides.
  - The library and the table both have 1585 entries, so the generator's `new Map(pairs)` dropped no duplicate key.
- sha256 ef08b22d…: NOT recomputed (no shell). A green CI run proves the committed data hashes to that digest. It does not prove the data equals the library; the only link is the generator's hand-run `--ts` check, plus my count and spot checks above.
- referenceKey (quest.ts:997-1001) is NFC, then `CASE_FOLD_MAP.get(char) ?? char`, with no toLowerCase fallback. That is exactly the library's caseFold (index.js:15-31: look up, else the char unchanged) applied after NFC, which is quest's aliasKey `caseFold(alias.normalize("NFC"))` (quest-cli records.ts:90-93, working tree).
- referenceKey's three callers are clean: link.ts:888-890, and quest.ts:1034 and :1053. Nothing on that route calls toLowerCase or toUpperCase. The remaining toLowerCase sites are the #749 should-fixes above, which are outside the referenceKey route.
- The digest pin (test :489-496) fails on any drift of LORE's committed bytes. CASE_FOLD_MAP is derived from those bytes at load. It cannot see quest; see should-fix 1.
- Test :549-566 makes String.prototype.toLowerCase throw. It is red under the previous `?? char.toLowerCase()`, a real guard.
- The generator half of #745 SF2 is resolved: the output now depends only on the bytes of the --lib file, not on the generating Node's toLowerCase.

Generator pass (scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs)
- It reads only the file named by --lib with readFileSync, extracts the literal with a regex and parses it with JSON.parse (:53-62). There is no import, eval or require, so no library code runs.
- Its output is deterministic:
  - the sort is numeric by first code point (:77);
  - JSON.stringify and a UTF-16 line budget lay out the lines;
  - the committed line 1 (37 entries, 110 units) reproduces the budget.
- `--ts` mode compares exactly, in order (:188-204).
- It does NOT enforce 1.1.1. It reads whatever --lib names and checks no shasum; the documented one (:41-43) is advisory. Under (a12) that file is the table's entire provenance (nit 2).
- "Committed equals output" is verified for the data only. `--ts` still compares just the data block, so byte-identity of the whole module is unchecked (nit 2).

The 7 code points
- Parity argument: CORRECT. lore and quest both compute caseFold(NFC(x)) over the same map, so the raw library value is irrelevant to parity.
- The writer's "11 keys NFC-decompose" is wrong; I count 13 (derived). They are U+1FBB, 1FBE, 1FC9, 1FCB, 1FD3, 1FDB, 1FE3, 1FEB, 1FF9, 1FFB, 2126, 212A and 212B. Six of those (1FBE, 1FD3, 1FE3, 2126, 212A, 212B) fold to the raw value after NFC; the seven oxia keys do not. The test's 7-list stands and the count appears in no code, so this is non-blocking.
- A raw-then-NFC mutant: test :525-537 does go red, but NOT because of the 7, since NFC(U+1F71) = U+03AC = fold(NFC(U+1FBB)) either way (derived). It goes red because full-fold outputs that NFC recomposes join `composed`: U+01F0→j+U+030C→ǰ, U+0390, U+03B0, U+1E96-1E99, U+1F50… A mutant with no NFC empties the list and is also red, as is :444.

Findings
Blocking: none.

Should-fix 1: the claim that the table "fails in whichever half lags" (case-fold-table.ts:9-10, quest.ts:989-991, generator :16-17) is currently false for quest.
- quest-cli (working tree) has no case-fold digest test. `unicode-case-folding` appears only in records.ts:1, package.json:83 (`^1.1.1`) and bun.lock:125.
- Failure scenario: a quest lockfile regen resolves 1.1.2, the two fold tables diverge, and both halves stay green.
- Route the quest-side pin as a pair item, since DEC-282 (a12)'s own sentence presumes it exists. Until then, reword the three comments to say that only lore's half is pinned.

Should-fix 2 (test hygiene): test :504-523, "referenceKey agrees with the library's caseFold at EVERY code point", is tautological.
- `libraryCaseFold` is referenceKey's own loop over the same CASE_FOLD_MAP, and `want = fold(NFC(key))` is referenceKey(key) by definition.
- It stays green under a toLowerCase-fallback mutant, because every character of NFC(key) is either a map key or already lowercase.
- The generator header (:26-27) counts it as drift protection ("and a per-entry agreement check").
- Fix: rename it as a self-consistency check and drop that claim, or compare against an independent oracle such as hard-coded CaseFolding.txt rows.

Nit 1: quest.ts:994-995. The empty-reference docblock (#745 nit 3) is still inaccurate.

Nit 2: the generator should check the --lib bytes against a pinned sha256 of index.js and refuse on mismatch. `--ts` could also compare the whole formatModule() output, so that "committed equals output" becomes checkable byte for byte.

Nit 3: no CHANGELOG line. The behaviour change is small (it only differs where the engine's toLowerCase disagreed with the map) but is (a12)-visible.

T — tracker and retarget (both PRs)
- LCLI-807 must not close on #749. AC1 still describes the toLowerCase digest pin that (a12) superseded, so reword it before checking it. AC3 (the handshake line on LBUMP/LCLI-469) is not visibly done in either PR.
- Watch the known trap: if LCLI-807 is completed on one branch while #750 still carries #749's original commits, the record exists in both tasks/ and completed/ and Tracker integrity exits 5.
- Retarget after the squash with `git rebase --onto origin/dev 2321b819`, which replays only #750's own commits.
- The hunks do not overlap. In quest.ts, #749's docblock change is at about :1045 and #750's at the import and :980-1001. In the generator, #750 leaves the #749 anchor line intact.
- After the rebase, prove the landed tree matches what was reviewed by diffing `git diff 2321b819 eba6d0dc` against `git diff <squash> <rebased-head>` on the 4 files, then re-run CI.
- If #749 picks up any further commit touching scripts/gen-case-fold-table.mjs or src/adapters/quest.ts, re-review #750's delta rather than carrying this verdict by SHA.

Rulings (leader 4a66daf3, 2026-11-21): #749 landed at 2321b819 as squash a5f008c1. #750 was closed by GitHub when #749's branch was deleted; its single commit eba6d0dc was cherry-picked onto origin/dev as 98ae1dba and carried by opum-ai/lore-cli#753 (new branch, no force-push). Approval carries by tree equality: git diff 2321b819 eba6d0dc and git diff a5f008c1 98ae1dba hash identically over the 4 files. LCLI-807 stays open: AC2 reworded to name the fold-table digest pin (the toLowerCase digest pin it named is superseded), checked only when #753 lands; AC4 (handshake) belongs to LBUMP; follow-ups in the task filed beside it.
